meaning:
1) to be or become many, be or become much, be or become great
1a)(Qal)
1a1) to be or become many
1a2) to be or become great
1a3) to be long (of journey)
2) (Pual) ten thousands

elsewhere.note: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.
Yahweh didn’t set his love on you nor choose you, because you were more in number than any people; for you were the fewest of all peoples;
Nabal answered David’s servants, and said, “Who is David? Who is the son of Jesse? There are many servants who break away from their masters these days.
If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?
Yahweh, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.
When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?
and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.
